ideas.title: Brainstorm with a model in your browser
ideas.what: Chrome has a small AI model built in, and it can suggest variations on every name you search. It runs right here on your computer, so what you type stays here — same as with the checks.
ideas.download: The first time, Chrome downloads the model: a few gigabytes, once. Chrome keeps it for any site that uses it, and you can remove it in Chrome’s settings.
ideas.where: For now, this works only in Chrome on a computer.
ideas.waiting: Chrome is downloading the model. Gigabytes take a while, and Chrome reports progress in big steps, so this may sit still for minutes. You can close this — variations start once the model is ready.
ideas.downloading: Chrome is downloading the model: {percent}%. You can close this — variations start once it’s ready.
ideas.failed: Chrome couldn’t start the model. Try again later?
ideas.stalled: Your browser hasn’t started the download. It knows about the model but can’t fetch it — browsers built on Chrome, like Arc, often can’t. Brainstorming works in Google Chrome itself.
